thread:
Maya C: UX flag — bulk rerun progress is misleading when many chunks are queued. The progress bar jumps (20% -> 90%) then stalls and users think it's done.
Diego H: Yep. Current bar counts only completed token work, not queued/blocked chunks.
Rae T: Proposal: show two compact indicators: (1) Processed: 180/420 cases with a small progress bar, (2) Queued: 240 queued. That keeps expectations correct.
Oliver P: Backend note: we sometimes return `scheduled_retry_at` per chunk. If present we can surface ETA. If not, show "Backoff in progress".
Maya C: Also add a tiny link "View chunk status" that opens run details and highlights queued chunks.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: announce count changes via aria-live polite. Don't auto-focus when the bar updates. Provide text alternatives for color-only pills.
Rae T: Microcopy candidate: "Processing 180 of 420 cases — 240 queued. Next attempt in ~30s." Keep it short.
Diego H: I'll file an infra ticket to expose total_counts and scheduled_retry_at in run status payload. Add per-chunk state: processed|queued|scheduled.
Maya C: I'll mock the dual-pill layout + live region behaviour and drop frames in #design later today :paintbrush:
Oliver P: Sounds good. Quick dev checklist: compute percentages client-side, show ETA when scheduled_retry_at exists, fallback copy otherwise.
Maya C: Assigning copy to @Rae T, API to @Diego H, a11y checklist to @a11y-bot. Ping here when drafts are in.
Rae T: Got it — will draft concise copy variants.
